newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends slightly down ahead of data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends slightly down ahead of data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended slightly lower in range trading with lack of big participation, easier soyoil and poor fundamental outlook dampening sentiment. The market awaits March 1-25 export data on Tuesday from SGS. June futures seen trading in 1,230-1,250 range.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Some selling was seen among nearby crude palm oil and selected products. Moved in line with futures.
"Now palm is entering into the high production months, and more fruits will be harvested and this may lead to a higher stock if demand remains slow," another trader said.
Prices had earlier opened much lower after falls in soyoil and lack of fresh developments triggered selling interest but some short-covering emerged at lower levels.
Among physicals, Mar (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,282.50 ringgit against bids of 1,280, after trading at 1,275 and 1,280.
Mar (central) saw offers at 1,270 against bids of 1,265 and Mar (north) at 1,250 against 1,245.
Apr (south) was offered at 1,282.50 with bids at 1,280 with early transactions at 1,275 and 1,277.50, and Apr (central) at 1,270 against 1,262.50.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $542.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May and June at $537.50, and July/Aug/Sep at $530.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $577.50, May at $572.50, Jun at $570 and July/Aug/Sep at 565. Apr was traded at $577.50 and $575, and May at $567.50.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $305.
